title: Lively Irish Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Irish dish featuring lamb, green olives, and a blend of herbs, cooked to perfection in a traditional clay tajine vessel, this recipe is sugar free friendly and offers an adventurous twist on traditional Irish cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay tajine vessel over medium heat on the stovetop.
Add the lamb cubes to the vessel and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the vessel and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped parsley, rosemary, salt, and pepper to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Add the green olives to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Cover the vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the vessel from the oven and stir in the crumbled feta cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
